# Compliance & Publication Readiness Requirements Checklist: Jisr MCP Server

**Purpose**: Validate that privacy, licensing, and public-release *requirements* are actually specified rather than deferred to an unnamed later review
**Created**: 2026-08-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness — Privacy

- [ ] CHK001 Are the PDPL obligations the product must be *designed for* enumerated, as distinct from those a legal review will assess? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 Are data-subject request procedures specified, or absent on the assumption that storing nothing removes the obligation? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 Is a retention requirement defined for the only data this release produces — logs and audit records? [Gap, Spec §FR-038]
- [ ] CHK004 Are data-residency requirements specified, or left entirely to the adopter without stating that choice? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the product's role under PDPL — controller, processor, or neither — stated for the self-hosted deployment? [Gap, Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for what the project tells adopters about their own PDPL obligations when self-hosting? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK007 Is purpose limitation expressed as a requirement on tool design, or only as a principle? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Completeness — Publication

- [ ] CHK008 Are the permissions the license must grant specified, rather than deferring the entire choice to publication time? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the publisher of record identified — personal, agency, or client — given the ownership question this raises? [Gap, Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK010 Are requirements defined for use of the Jisr name in the project name, repository, and package, and for stating that the project is unofficial? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK011 Are trademark and attribution requirements specified for referencing a third party's product? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the security disclosure policy requirement specify a contact route and a response expectation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements defined for what the changelog must record about security-relevant changes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK014 Are supply-chain requirements specified for publishing — provenance, signing, and account protection? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK015 Are contributor licensing requirements specified, so external contributions can be accepted safely? [Gap, Spec §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK016 Are third-party dependency license-compatibility requirements defined? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK017 Is "no real credential, employee, or payroll data" given an enforceable definition, when automated scanning detects secrets but not synthetic-looking personal data? [Measurability, Spec §FR-042]
- [ ] CHK018 Is "qualified legal review" specified in terms of jurisdiction and scope, so it can be commissioned? [Clarity, Spec §Dependencies]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the boundary of "publishable publicly" defined — which artifacts are in the public repository and which are not? [Clarity, Spec §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK020 Is it specified whether this specification set and the baseline plan are themselves published, given they document a client's integration? [Gap, Ambiguity]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK021 Are the two external release gates — legal review and license decision — recorded consistently in spec, plan, and quickstart? [Consistency, quickstart.md]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the "permissive license" assumption consistent with any commercial constraint arising from the client relationship this work sits inside? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK023 Do the privacy statements in the spec and the constitution's PDPL section agree on what is designed for versus reviewed? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK024 Is SC-012 ("100% of Definition of Done items satisfied") traceable to a specific, versioned Definition of Done? [Traceability, Spec §SC-012]
- [ ] CHK025 Are measurable criteria defined for publication readiness, or is it treated as a judgement call? [Gap, Measurability]
- [ ] CHK026 Can the requirement that no real data exists in the repository be evaluated against history as well as the current tree? [Measurability, Spec §FR-042]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements defined for what happens if legal review returns findings after publication? [Coverage, Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements specified for withdrawing or yanking a published version found to leak data? [Gap, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for handling a vulnerability report from an external researcher? [Coverage, Spec §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements specified for the case where Jisr objects to the project's existence or naming? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK031 Is the assumption recorded that publishing an unofficial integration for a third-party HR platform carries no contractual barrier? [Assumption, Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the dependency on legal review scoped so it does not silently block the entire release? [Clarity, Spec §Dependencies]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- CHK009, CHK010, CHK020 and CHK022 are commercial rather than technical, and are the items most likely to be settled outside this repository. They are listed because publishing resolves them by default if nobody decides them deliberately
